writeup: TIC 373792319 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 16.1981 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse that dims the system by 8.98%, along with a secondary eclipse detected at 7.7 sigma significance. The binary-search algorithm identified this candidate with a signal-to-noise ratio of 272.0, while difference imaging analysis confirmed the signal originates near the target location, with a peak signal-to-noise of 90.2 and a centroid offset of 2.7 arcsec. This candidate does not appear in six variable-star catalogs, and the automated pipeline's machine learning screening assigned it a score of 0.72. All data quality checks passed without flagging any concerns, making this a promising candidate for further investigation.
